title: Comparative Observational Study of Supra-annular Versus Intra-annular Self-expanding Aortic Valves in Routine Clinical Practice
official: Comparative Observational Study of Supra-annular Versus Intra-annular Self-expanding Aortic Valves in Routine Clinical Practice
summary: We proposed to compare in an observational study procedural success at one month (VARC 3 criteria) and clinical and echographic follow-up at 6 months between 2 self expandable devices in TAVR : the supra annular Evolut device (Medtronic) vs the intra anular NAVITOR device (Abott)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* all patients elligible for TAVR witn a self expandable device

Exclusion Criteria:

* femoral access not suitable
* valve in valve procedures
